turns.question: What was our total revenue over 1 and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: Revenue (non-cancelled orders) was EUR 1,850.34 over 1 and 2 October 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: And broken down by customer country, how much of it came from Germany?
turns.answer: Of that, EUR 410.75 of revenue came from customers in Germany (DE) over 1 and 2 October 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
